Blaze.description: Starter deck. Torchic grows into Blaziken, with Camerupt and Arcanine backing it up. Simple and hard-hitting.

Torrent.description: Starter deck. Mudkip grows into Swampert, which heals itself with Water Energy. Wailord is a big wall and Pelipper helps out.

Overgrow.description: Starter deck. Treecko grows into Sceptile, which moves Grass Energy around. Nuzleaf and the fast Ninjask keep up the pressure.

Ruby.description: EX Ruby & Sapphire theme deck: Blaziken, Hariyama and Delcatty (Fire and Fighting).

Sapphire.description: EX Ruby & Sapphire theme deck: Swampert, Grovyle and Weezing (Water and Grass).

Oasis.description: EX Sandstorm theme deck: Armaldo, Sandslash and Azumarill (Fighting and Water), with Claw Fossil.

Caravan.description: EX Sandstorm theme deck: Cradily, Arcanine and Nuzleaf (Grass and Fire), with Root Fossil.

WindBlast.description: EX Dragon theme deck: Flygon, Ninjask and Magneton (Grass and Lightning).

FireFang.description: EX Dragon theme deck: Salamence, Camerupt and Crawdaunt (Fire and Water).

Team Magma.description: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua theme deck: Team Magma's Groudon, Aggron, Claydol and Houndoom.

Team Aqua.description: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua theme deck: Team Aqua's Kyogre, Walrein, Lanturn and Mightyena.

Wish Maker.description: EX Hidden Legends theme deck: Jirachi, Metagross, Starmie and Tentacruel (Psychic and Water).

Forest Guardian.description: EX Hidden Legends theme deck: Dark Celebi, Bellossom, Dodrio and Loudred (Grass and Colorless).

Magma Spirit (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Champion, 15-and-over division: Tsuguyoshi Yamato (Japan), undefeated. Team Magma's Groudon and Zangoose with Magma Energy.

Blaziken Tech (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 15-and-over division: Chris Fulop (USA). Blaziken and Blaziken ex with Delcatty, Rayquaza ex and Rare Candy.

Team Rushdown (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 11-14 division: Kevin Nguyen (USA). Gardevoir and Gardevoir ex with Boost Energy and Magneton.

Rocky Beach (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 10-and-under division: Reed Weichler (USA). Swampert, Swampert ex and Suicune ex.

Echo.description: Expedition theme deck: Alakazam copies the opponent's attacks, backed by Haunter, Clefable and Chansey (Psychic and Colorless).

Electric Garden.description: Expedition theme deck: Vileplume, Weezing, Raichu and Flaaffy (Grass and Lightning).

Rock Garden.description: Aquapolis theme deck: Nidoking, Exeggutor, Marowak and Blissey (Grass and Fighting).

Abyss.description: Aquapolis theme deck: Kingdra, Ninetales, Porygon2 and Miltank (Fire and Water).

Eeveelution.description: Skyridge theme deck: Eevee evolves into Vaporeon, Flareon or Jolteon, backed by Electrode, Lapras and Ursaring (Fire, Water and Lightning).

Mind Machine.description: Skyridge theme deck: Xatu takes any Technical Machine, with the three Miracle Spheres, Ditto, Snorlax and Raticate (Psychic and every basic Energy).

Jessie.description: Team Rocket Returns theme deck: Dark Tyranitar and Dark Marowak hit hard, with Dark Arbok and Rocket's Wobbuffet in support (Fighting, Grass and Psychic).

Starcharge.description: Deoxys theme deck: fast Psychic and Grass attackers led by Deoxys, with Shiftry, Shedinja and Meteor Falls.

Jetstream.description: Deoxys theme deck: Fire, Lightning and Water Pokémon soften up the opponent before Rayquaza swoops in.

Hydrobloom.description: Emerald theme deck: Water and Grass Pokémon wear the opponent down while Feebas evolves into Milotic.

Wildfire.description: Emerald theme deck: Fire and Lightning Pokémon blaze through the opponent's defenses, with two Manectric and Blaziken.

FireRed.description: FireRed & LeafGreen theme deck: Charmander grows into Charmeleon, with Arcanine and Pidgeot (Fire, Water and Colorless).

LeafGreen.description: FireRed & LeafGreen theme deck: Ivysaur, Beedrill and Magneton outwit the opponent (Grass, Lightning and Colorless).

James.description: Team Rocket Returns theme deck: Dark Dragonair finds Dark Dragonite with Evolutionary Light, with Dark Weezing and Dark Magneton (Water, Lightning and Grass).

Golden Sky.description: Unseen Forces theme deck: Ho-Oh, Typhlosion and Magcargo burn through with Fire and Fighting Energy.

Silvery Ocean.description: Unseen Forces theme deck: Lugia and Meganium lead Grass and Psychic Pokémon, with Fluffy Berry and Protective Orb.

Breakthrough.description: Delta Species theme deck: Crobat δ, Dragonair δ and Holon's Electrode with Grass, Lightning and Metal Energy.

Steeplechase.description: Delta Species theme deck: Shelgon δ, Umbreon δ and Rapidash race ahead with Fire and Metal Energy.

Groundbreaker.description: Legend Maker theme deck: Golem and fossil Pokémon dig in with Grass, Fighting and React Energy.

Shadowquake.description: Legend Maker theme deck: Gengar haunts the field alongside Water Pokémon, with React Energy and Power Tree.

FireMist.description: Holon Phantoms theme deck: Latias δ and Blaziken with Mankey δ and Exeggcute δ, on Fire and Fighting Energy.

FloodRush.description: Holon Phantoms theme deck: Latios δ, Bellossom δ and fossil Omanyte δ on Water and Psychic Energy.

Green Cyclone.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Venusaur's Chlorophyll powers Grass Pokémon like Grovyle and Loudred.

Storm Surge.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Blastoise with Charmeleon δ, Fearow δ and Pelipper δ on Water and Lightning Energy.

Earth Shower.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Swampert, Dugtrio and Medicham shake the ground with Water and Fighting Energy.

Power Wave.description: Dragon Frontiers theme deck: Feraligatr δ's Battle Aura and Cloyster δ guard a δ team on Lightning and Fighting Energy.

Shadow Blaze.description: Dragon Frontiers theme deck: Typhlosion δ, Arbok δ and Lickitung δ with Fire and Psychic Energy.

Mind Game.description: Power Keepers theme deck: Gardevoir, Dusclops and Sableye play with Phoebe's Stadium on Psychic and Water Energy.

Dark Blast.description: Power Keepers theme deck: Mightyena and Sidney's Stadium lead a Fire and Darkness team.

Psychic Mimic.description: Alakazam remembers everything it has ever seen. Mr. Mime shapes that memory into walls of air.

Haunted Mansion.description: The old mansion has stood empty for a hundred years. On quiet nights, its ghosts still hold their parties.

Embrace.description: Gardevoir senses its trainer's feelings from far away. It will cross any distance to protect them.

Cosmic Duo.description: Lunatone and Solrock fell from the sky on the same night. Since then, the stars seem a little closer.

Thunderbolt.description: Pikachu store lightning in their cheeks. When many gather, the night sky glows over the forest.

Lighthouse.description: They say the lighthouse keeper vanished one stormy night. Ampharos has kept the light burning ever since.

Magnetic Field.description: Near the old power plant, compasses spin and the air hums. Magneton drift there like quiet clouds.

Evolution Prism.description: Eevee carries many futures inside it. A single stone decides which one it will live.

Charizard Blaze.description: Charizard flies over mountains in search of worthy rivals. Its flame burns brighter with every battle.

Firestarter.description: Torchic's small flame never goes out, even in the rain. One day it will become the fire that guides Blaziken.

Volcano.description: Villagers near the volcano leave offerings each spring. They say a great beast of fire sleeps inside.

Will-o'-the-Wisp.description: Ghostly lights drift through the forest at night. Travelers who follow them find Ninetales waiting.

Egg Bomb.description: Exeggcute huddle together and share their thoughts. When they grow, the jungle grows with them.

Cotton Breeze.description: Each spring the town fills with floating cotton. Hoppip ride the wind until it carries them home.

Leaf Storm.description: Shiftry lives in the oldest part of the forest. With a sweep of its fans, the wind obeys.

Silver Wind.description: On summer nights the meadow shimmers with wings. Beautifly and Dustox dance until dawn.

Toxic Cloud.description: Deep in the swamp, the air turns purple. Crobat flies through it as easily as through clear sky.

Jungle Strike.description: Sceptile moves from branch to branch without a sound. The forest protects those it trusts.

Flower Garden.description: The most beautiful garden in Hoenn grows wild and untended. Its flowers protect themselves.

Overgrowth.description: Ancient vines cover the ruins of an old city. Venusaur and Meganium watch over the new forest.

Bug Collection.description: A young collector spent a whole summer in the woods. These are the friends that followed them home.

Poison Kingdom.description: Nidoking and Nidoqueen rule the thorny plains together. Their family grows strong under their care.

Hoenn Fossils.description: In Mr. Stone's lab, creatures from an ancient sea open their eyes again after millions of years.

Kanto Fossils.description: Miners in Mt. Moon found shells in the rock. Some of them were still waiting to wake up.

Chaos Flash.description: When Golduck's eyes glow, the stream falls silent. Even the crabs stop to listen.

Deep Dive.description: Wailord's song travels across the whole ocean. Sailors say it sounds like a lullaby.

Sea Dragon.description: Old fishermen speak of a dragon sleeping under the whirlpool. When it wakes, the tide changes.

Rain Dance.description: Ludicolo dances whenever it hears music. In Hoenn, they say its dance calls the rain.

Permafrost.description: Far inside the frozen cave, Regice has slept for ages. The ice around it never melts.

Seafoam Islands.description: Two islands of ice and foam rest off the Kanto coast. Lapras carries travelers between them.

Major Tsunami.description: Feraligatr guards the river where it was born. When it rises, the water rises with it.

Hydro Cannon.description: Blastoise's cannons can put out a forest fire. Poliwrath swims upstream to join it.

Raging Sea.description: Magikarp endure every current without complaint. One day, the sea learns what they became.

Legendary Waters.description: Ancient texts tell of a beast that raised the oceans. Suicune runs across the waves to keep them pure.

Mud Wave.description: Swampert is the gentle king of the marsh. Lanturn lights the way through the murky water.

Dragon Dance.description: Dragons of every color gather on the Sky Pillar. Their dance is older than any human city.

Eon Twins.description: Latios and Latias can turn invisible in the light. Only those with a kind heart ever see them.

Lazy Day.description: Slaking spends its days lying in the grass. When it finally rises, the ground trembles.

Sandstorm.description: In the desert, the dunes seem to sing at dusk. Flygon is the one singing.

Sky High.description: The birds of the route know every wind current by heart. They reach the clouds before anyone else.

Lucky Eggs.description: Chansey share their eggs with anyone who is hurt. Kindness is their greatest strength.

Moonlight.description: On full moon nights, Clefairy gather on Mt. Moon to dance. Their song drifts down to the valley.

City Pests.description: The city's back alleys have their own quiet community. Linoone finds treasures no one else notices.

Hyper Voice.description: Exploud's voice can be heard across the whole valley. Its friends harmonize as best they can.

Overzealous.description: Machamp trains from sunrise to sunset. Its four arms never tire.

Martial Arts Dojo.description: In the mountain dojo, Hitmonchan, Hitmonlee and Hitmontop train under one master.

Rock Slide.description: Golem live high in the mountains. When they roll down the slopes, the whole valley hears them.

Earthquake.description: The old legends say Groudon raised the continents. When it stirs, the ground remembers.

Iron Wall.description: Aggron claims an entire mountain as its home. It guards every stone of it.

Meteor Mash.description: Beldum fell from the stars long ago. Metagross still looks up at night as if remembering.

Dark Aura.description: Tyranitar walks alone through the mountains. The land shapes itself around its path.

Night Howl.description: Absol appears before disasters to warn those nearby. Mightyena's howl follows close behind.

Magma Strike.description: Team Magma dreams of a world with more land to walk on. Deep below them, Groudon answers their call.

Magma Eruption.description: The volcano is Team Magma's home. They speak of Camerupt's eruptions the way others speak of sunrise.

Aqua Assault.description: Team Aqua believes all life began in the sea and should return to it. Kyogre stirs at their call.

Aqua Ambush.description: Team Aqua's scouts move with the tide and strike with the storm. Lanturn lights their way through dark water.

Poltergeist.description: Gengar hides in the shadow of anyone who walks alone at night. It only wants someone to play with.

Psychic Link.description: Kirlia and Gardevoir share a single mind. Xatu sees the future and waits for it calmly.

Moon and Sun.description: Lunatone and Solrock circle each other like the sky itself. Mewtwo ex watches them from afar.

Space Virus.description: A meteor fell near the Space Center. The creature inside changes its shape to meet any challenge.

Big Eggsplosion.description: Each of Exeggutor's heads dreams a different dream. Slowbro is content to dream none at all.

Eevee Party.description: When Eevee gather, every evolution comes to celebrate. Kecleon and Ditto blend right in.

Mega Thunder.description: Storm clouds gather over the power plant. Raichu ex and Zapdos ex fly through the lightning.

Conductivity.description: Ampharos shines brighter with every spark it gathers. Its light reaches ships far out at sea.

Energy Bomb.description: The old power plant hums day and night. Electrode store its energy until the moment is right.

Burn Down.description: Charizard ex can melt boulders with its breath. It only shows that fire to a true rival.

Blaze Kick.description: Blaziken's legs burst into flame when it fights. Camerupt ex and Torkoal keep its fire fed.

Fire Spin.description: Typhlosion ex and Arcanine run where the volcano's fire flows. Entei ex leads them.

Nine Tails.description: Ninetales is said to live a thousand years. Its nine tails hold the wisdom of every one of them.

Energy Trans.description: Venusaur ex soaks up the sunlight with the great flower on its back. The jungle blooms around it.

Spore Cloud.description: The meadow fills with drifting cotton and spores. Anything that breathes it drifts into gentle sleep.

Fan Away.description: Shiftry's fans call the wind of the old forest. Pinsir and Heracross guard the trees.

Wing Dust.description: Beautifly and Dustox scatter their dust under the moon. The meadow glitters until morning.

Venom Wing.description: Crobat ex flies so quietly that nothing hears it coming. Its friends wait in the swamp below.

Forest Blade.description: The forest is Sceptile's kingdom. Its leaf blades cut cleanly through the thickest branches.

Block Dust.description: Vileplume ex's petals release a heavy pollen. Nothing works quite the same inside its garden.

Wonder Guard.description: When Nincada evolves, it leaves a shell behind. The shell becomes Shedinja and starts to move.

Royal Poison.description: Nidoking and Nidoqueen rule the thorny wastes. Cacturne ex guards the gates of their desert.

Ancient Claws.description: Armaldo ex and Cradily ex ruled the ancient seas. Mr. Stone's lab has brought them back.

Primal Lock.description: Aerodactyl ex's ancient roar silences the modern world. For a moment, the fossil age returns.

Crab Hammer.description: Kingler and Crawdaunt guard the beaches. Golduck watches over them from the nearby stream.

Whale Song.description: Wailord ex is the largest Pokémon ever found. Pelipper nest on its back as it crosses the sea.

Dragon Whirlpool.description: Kingdra rests on the ocean floor. When it rises, a great whirlpool forms above it.

Reflect Energy.description: Milotic ex is said to calm any quarrel. Its scales shine with every color of the rain.

Ice Age.description: Regice ex and Articuno ex bring the winter wherever they go. Snow falls even in summer.

Kanto Shores.description: Starmie, Dewgong and Cloyster live along the Kanto coast. The tide brings them together.

Hydro Pump.description: Blastoise ex braces its shell and fires. Poliwrath and Tentacruel swim at its side.

Red Tide.description: A red Gyarados was seen in the lake. Since then, the sea has not been calm.

Tidal Legends.description: Kyogre ex calls the rain and Suicune ex runs across it. The old legends of the sea are awake.

Muddy Water.description: Swampert ex shapes the marsh with its strong arms. Quagsire and Whiscash make their homes there.

Dragon Wave.description: Dragonite ex and Rayquaza ex fly above the clouds. Altaria's song follows them through the sky.

Dragon Lift.description: Bagon dreamed of flying all its life. As Salamence ex, it finally rides the wind.

Eon Flight.description: Latios and Latias fly faster than any jet. They never travel far from each other.

Slack Off.description: Slaking rests between every battle. When it fights, it gives everything it has.

Sand Guard.description: Flygon's wings raise a sandstorm to guard the desert oasis. Few travelers ever find it.

Drive Off.description: Dodrio and Swellow defend the skies of their route. Every bird there knows its place.

Egg Surprise.description: Every Chansey carries a special egg. They share it with anyone who needs help.

Sleepy Song.description: Wigglytuff ex's song lulls even the fiercest rival to sleep. Clefable ex keeps time.

Pickup Crew.description: Linoone and its friends roam the city streets. They always find something worth keeping.

Uproar.description: Exploud's band plays in the town square every evening. Ditto and Kecleon join the chorus.

Cross Chop.description: Machamp can throw a thousand punches in a minute. Hariyama ex stands firm beside it.

Pure Power.description: Medicham ex meditates on the mountaintop until its strength overflows.

Rock Tumble.description: Golem ex curls up and rolls down the mountainside. Rhydon follows through the dust.

Magnitude.description: Groudon ex raised the land from the sea. Donphan and Dugtrio still feel its footsteps.

Steel Fortress.description: Aggron ex and Registeel ex stand like a wall of iron. Skarmory patrols the skies above.

Comet Punch.description: Metagross ex links four minds into one. Its punches fall like meteors.

Sand Damage.description: Wherever Tyranitar walks, a sandstorm follows. Even the dark Tyranitar keep their distance.

Bad News.description: Absol comes down from the mountains to warn of danger. Mightyena's pack watches the night.

Rocket's Poison Gas.description: Team Rocket's labs breed Pokémon in dark rooms. Dark Crobat and Dark Weezing were raised there.

Rocket's Power Plant.description: Team Rocket has taken over the power plant. Dark Ampharos lights their secret base.

Rocket's Tidal Wave.description: Team Rocket has stolen the legends of the sea. Dark Gyarados guards their submarine.

Rocket's Furnace.description: Team Rocket's forge burns with stolen fire. Dark Houndoom guards its gates.

Rocket's Quarry.description: Deep in the mine, Team Rocket digs for buried treasure. Dark Steelix bores through the rock.

Rocket's Dragons.description: Team Rocket's darkest experiment awakened Dark Dragonite. Dark Hypno keeps it calm.

Rocket's Elite.description: The Rocket boss keeps his rarest Pokémon close. Rocket's Mewtwo ex leads them.

Magma Hideout.description: Inside the volcano, Team Magma waits for the right moment. Groudon sleeps beneath their feet.

Overheat.description: Team Magma's furnaces never cool. Camerupt and Houndoom guard the lava pits.

Aqua Hideout.description: Team Aqua's hideout opens to the sea. Kyogre waits in the deep water below the dock.

Power Shift.description: Team Aqua's lightning squad charges up in the dark. Raikou ex and Zapdos ex fight beside them.

Shadow Curse.description: Gengar and Banette ex live where the light doesn't reach. Mirrors show them more clearly than eyes do.

Heal Dance.description: Gardevoir dances in the moonlight and every wound closes. Xatu watches over the dance.

Eclipse.description: When the moon covers the sun, Grumpig and Hypno sing the world into a gentle sleep.

Forme Change.description: Deoxys shifts between attack, defense and speed. No one has seen its true form.

Psychic Exchange.description: Slowking wears a crown of wisdom. Exeggutor's heads trade thoughts like old friends.

Genetic Code.description: Mew is said to carry the genes of every Pokémon. Deep in the Mirage Forest, Celebi ex and the Unown guard that secret.

Prism Burst.description: Five Eeveelutions shine in five colors. Ho-Oh ex and Lugia ex answer the rainbow.

Pika Bolt.description: Pikachu's cheeks spark when it is happy. Raichu ex and Pikachu ★ fill the field with light.

Energy Connect.description: Ampharos links every light in the valley. Raikou ★ runs through the storm above.

Reactive Recharge.description: Magneton keep the circuits of the old plant alive. Electrode ex waits for its moment.

Energy Flame.description: Charizard ex grows stronger the more fire it gathers. Moltres ex burns across the sky.

Eruption.description: Camerupt ex carries a volcano on its back. Blaziken leaps from the smoke when it erupts.

Bursting Up.description: Typhlosion ex bursts from the flames. Arcanine ex and Entei ★ gallop at its side.

Fox Fire.description: Ninetales lights ghostly flames in the night forest. Houndoom answers with a distant howl.

Hard Plant.description: Venusaur's roots crack stone and lift whole forests. Life follows wherever it walks.

Johto Garden.description: Meganium's flowers heal the tired land. Celebi visits from the future to see them bloom.

Miracle Powder.description: Jumpluff drifts wherever the wind takes it. Venomoth and Ledian follow its gentle path.

Stadium Power.description: Shiftry rules the old forest stadium. Under the Power Tree, its fans call the storm.

Dust Storm.description: Dustox ex's silver wind sweeps through the meadow. Beautifly sparkles in the light.

Triple Poison.description: Crobat ex dives through the toxic swamp. Weezing and Muk make their home in the haze.

Green Essence.description: Sceptile draws its strength from the oldest trees. Breloom springs from the forest floor.

Full Bloom.description: When Vileplume ex blooms, the whole garden falls still and listens.

Swords Dance.description: Ninjask moves so quickly it seems to vanish. The shell it leaves behind becomes Shedinja.

Family Bonds.description: Nidoking and Nidoqueen protect their family with horn and venom. Cacturne ex guards the sands.

Root and Claw.description: Anorith and Lileep have slept in stone for millions of years. Armaldo ex leads them back to life.

Fossil Excavation.description: Holon Fossils lie among the stone domes of Holon Lake. Kabutops and Omastar wake again from the stone.

Splash Back.description: Kingler and Crawdaunt ex guard the reef. Dark Golduck watches from the deep.

Reactive Lift.description: Wailord rises from the deep like a living island. Pelipper and Luvdisc travel on its back.

Suction Cups.description: Kingdra rests on the ocean floor. Octillery clings to the reef nearby.

Swing Dance.description: Ludicolo's dance brings the rain. Milotic ex glides through it like a living rainbow.

Icy Aura.description: Walrein ex brings the blizzard. The Regice trio guards the frozen cave.

Aurora Beam.description: On cold nights, the Kanto coast glows with aurora light. Suicune ★ runs across the waves.

Energy Rain.description: Blastoise ex raises its cannons to the sky. The rain falls on friend and foe alike.

Twister.description: Gyarados ex rises from the storm. Sharpedo ex and Huntail follow it through the waves.

Mark of Antiquity.description: The ancient markings on Kyogre ex's body glow as it wakes. The ocean rises with it.

Water Cyclone.description: Swampert spins a whirlpool through the marsh. Mudkip ★ plays in the current.

Intimidating Fang.description: Feraligatr guards the river with its great jaws. Croconaw learns by its side.

Bright Flame.description: For years, Bagon dreamed of flight. Now Salamence ex and Rayquaza ★ share the sky.

Shining Star.description: A shooting star crossed the sky and did not fall. Latios ★ was flying home.

Lazy Aura.description: Slaking rests so deeply that the world around it slows. When it rises, it hits for 100.

Emerge Charge.description: Flygon ex waits beneath the sand. Marowak and Gligar guard the desert with it.

Quick Search.description: Pidgeot spots its target from high above the clouds. Dodrio and Swellow race to it.

Blissful Support.description: Blissey ex cares for every Pokémon on the bench. Latias ★ shines a healing light.

Metronome.description: Clefable ex waves its finger and anything can happen. The fairies of Mt. Moon watch in wonder.

Thick Skin.description: Persian watches over the city from the rooftops. The alley crew trusts it with their treasures.

Mega Throw.description: Exploud's voice fills the valley. Its band of unusual Pokémon follows every note.

Brick Smash.description: Machamp trains by breaking bricks at dawn. Hariyama ex joins it in the ring.

Hitmon Dojo.description: Hitmonchan, Hitmonlee and Hitmontop train under one master. Medicham ex keeps the peace.

Rock Hurl.description: Golem rolls down the mountain slopes. Groudon ★ splits the earth below.

Healing Stone.description: Regirock ex heals with stones older than any city. Donphan and Groudon shake the ground.

Steel Wing.description: Registeel's iron body never rusts. Scizor ex and Steelix ex guard its kingdom of steel.

Super Connectivity.description: Metagross links four minds into one. Metagross ★ shines like a fallen star.

Losing Control.description: Tyranitar ex carves its own path through the mountains. Dark Tyranitar follows in its footsteps.

Driving Howl.description: Mightyena ex's howl echoes across the valley. Absol and Sableye wait in the shadows.

Rocket's Smog.description: Team Rocket's lab seeps green fog into the night. Dark Crobat and Dark Weezing were born in it.

Rocket's Generator.description: Team Rocket powers its base with stolen lightning. Rocket's Raikou ex runs the generator.

Rocket's Undertow.description: Team Rocket's submarine prowls the deep. Rocket's Suicune ex guards the hatch.

Rocket's Inferno.description: Team Rocket's forge glows red through the night. Rocket's Entei ex and Moltres ex feed the fire.

Rocket's Bunker.description: Team Rocket dug a bunker under the mountain. Dark Steelix guards its tunnels.

Rocket's Dark Trance.description: Dark Dragonite rose from Team Rocket's darkest lab. Dark Hypno keeps it in a trance.

Rocket's Night Cry.description: When Rocket's Persian ex cries in the night, the boss's finest Pokémon are ready.

Delta Dragons.description: Holon's research tower woke a hidden power in Dragonite and Salamence. They now carry Lightning and Fire.

Holon Flame.description: Fire burns in many of Holon's Delta Species. Tyranitar δ and Mewtwo δ were found near the tower, Kingdra δ by the lake.

Delta Storm.description: Holon's tower brought out Metagross δ's dormant power. At Holon Lake, Gyarados δ and Pidgeot δ crackle with Lightning.

Delta Prism.description: Eevee adapt to wherever they live. In Holon, the tower's field made them adapt into something new.

Holon Bloom.description: Starmie δ and Azumarill δ swim in Holon's canals. South, at Holon Lake, Bellossom δ dances among the stone domes.

Holon Circuit.description: While studying Delta Species, Holon's researchers found Pokémon that can become Energy. They named them Holon's Pokémon.

Delta Swarm.description: Beedrill δ and Crobat δ buzz around Holon's orchards. Flygon δ glides over the tall grass by Holon Lake.

Delta Pack.description: Mightyena δ, Marowak δ and Sandslash δ roam the forests around Holon. Sharpedo δ hunts in the lake to the south.

Dark Palm.description: Dusknoir guides lost spirits to the other side. Its open hand is cold and patient.

Imprison.description: Gardevoir heals with its dance. Gardevoir ex δ comes from the islands beyond the horizon, where dragons rule.

Type Shift.description: Claydol ex can change the colors of the world around it. Lunatone and Solrock spin overhead.

Unown Puzzle.description: The walls of the ancient ruins are covered in Unown. Alakazam ★ is reading them slowly.

Forme Shift.description: Deoxys came from space and learned to change its shape. Starmie guides it through our world.

Ominous Wind.description: Drifblim drifts over town on autumn evenings. Drapion waits quietly in the sand below.

Mythical Mew.description: Mew is said to live deep in the Mirage Forest. Celebi travels through time and Mewtwo ★ remembers them both.

Evolution Rays.description: Espeon ★ shines a purple light and Eevee begins to change. Ho-Oh ex brings every color.

Volt Tackle.description: Electivire's arrival lights up the whole power grid. Pikachu ★ sparkles in the storm.

Gleam Eyes.description: Luxray's golden eyes see through walls. Pachirisu carries messages through the storm.

Static Flock.description: Mareep's wool gathers static on the hillsides. Ampharos and Jolteon ★ guide the flock.

Magnetize.description: Magnezone came from Sinnoh. Every magnet in the land turns to face it.

Fire Fang.description: Charizard returned from a long journey. Charizard ★ came back with the dark flames of the frontier.

Burn Away.description: Blaziken ex's flames burn away all doubt. Camerupt ex and Arbok keep the fire close.

Flame Swirl.description: Arcanine ex can run a thousand miles in a single day. Entei ★ runs at its side.

Flare Up.description: Infernape's head burns brighter when it fights for others. Ninetales and Flareon ★ stand beside it.

Forest Murmurs.description: Torterra carries a small forest on its back. Some say Celebi ★ sleeps among its trees.

Solar Garden.description: Venusaur and Meganium ex bathe in the morning sun. Sunflora greets the day with a dance.

Attack Order.description: Vespiquen commands her hive with a single hum. Roserade guards the flowers they visit.

Dark Eyes.description: Shiftry ex's eyes see through every trick. The forest grows quiet when it passes.

Silk Road.description: Dustox ex and Beautifly glide over the meadow at dusk. Masquerain watches from the pond.

Poison Ring.description: Crobat ex circles high above the swamp. Weezing and Muk drift through the haze below.

Leaf Blade.description: Sceptile's leaves are sharper than any sword. Sceptile ex δ came from a remote island of glowing crystals.

Stun Spore Garden.description: Vileplume shakes its petals and the garden falls still. Victreebel waits beneath the leaves.

Loose Shell.description: Ninjask sheds its shell in an instant. The empty shell rises as Shedinja.

Dark Horn.description: On the furthest islands, an old hermit lives among red cliffs. Nidoking δ and Nidoqueen δ roam the same valley.

Fossil Charge.description: Armaldo and Cradily march out of the ancient past. The old reef comes back to life.

Ancient Shell.description: Shells and claws stir at the dig site. Aerodactyl calls from the cliffs above.

Brine.description: Empoleon rules the frozen sea. Floatzel and Manaphy swim through its kingdom.

Pincer Pond.description: Kingler and Crawdaunt ex guard the pond. Latios ex and Palkia watch over it from afar.

Whale Watch.description: Wailord rises like an island in the open sea. Sailors once saw Mew riding on its back.

Protective Swirl.description: Kingdra ex δ hides in its own smoke off the rocky coast of the furthest islands. Octillery clings to the reef nearby.

Rain Splash.description: Ludicolo dances and the rain begins. Milotic ex shines with every color of the storm.

Glacia's Blizzard.description: Glacia of the Elite Four calls the blizzard. Walrein ex and the Regice trio answer.

Frozen Kiss.description: Jynx sings across the frozen bay. Suicune ★ runs over the ice.

Ultra Pump.description: Swampert ex shapes the marsh with its powerful arms. Quagsire floats peacefully nearby.

Smash Turn.description: Blastoise guards the waterfall pool. Politoed ex calls the frogs of the falls to its side.

Hydro Fangs.description: Gyarados rises above the waves. Vaporeon ★ melts into the water and disappears.

Primal Tide.description: Kyogre ex and Palkia meet where the sea reaches the edge of space.

Tsunami Fang.description: Feraligatr's tsunami crashes onto the shore. Sudowoodo watches from the riverbank.

Salamence Sky.description: Salamence ex rules the sky and Rayquaza ★ shines above it. Blissey ex tends to the wounded.

Eon Duet.description: Latias ex δ and Latios ex δ fly between the floating island and the sea below. Latios ★ flies with them.

Slack Attack.description: Slaking finally rises from its long rest. Lopunny bounds along beside it.

Sand Pit.description: Flygon ex waits at the bottom of the sand pit. Latias ★ heals those lost in the dunes.

Brave Bird.description: Staraptor never retreats, even from rivals twice its size. Dodrio and Pidgeot fly with it.

Moon Kick.description: Clefable and Delcatty ex lead the dance on Mt. Moon. The fairies follow the starlight.

High Hat.description: Purugly rules the back alleys with quiet authority. The city crew follows it everywhere.

Scavenge.description: Bibarel gathers everything that floats downstream. Its friends help build its riverside home.

Aura Sphere.description: Lucario reads the aura of every living thing. The Hitmon masters spar in its dojo.

Dynamic Punch.description: Machamp's four arms move like a storm. Hariyama ex stands firm in the ring.

Earth Fissure.description: Rhyperior cracks the earth with its drill. Groudon ★ rises from the fissure.

Ground Slash.description: Donphan rolls across the plains and the ground shakes. Regirock ex guards the ancient stones.

Metal Gravity.description: Skarmory ex and Aggron ex hold the iron mountain. Dialga watches over the flow of time.

Steel Slash.description: Steelix coils through the mountain's iron veins. Scizor ex cuts with steel wings.

Meteor Fist.description: Jirachi ex wakes once every thousand years to grant a wish. Metagross keeps watch while it sleeps.

Shatter.description: Tyranitar ex reshapes the mountains as it walks. Tyranitar δ, born near Holon's tower, follows its path.

Cursed Eyes.description: Absol ex appears before every storm. Weavile and Skuntank prowl under Umbreon ★'s dark light.

Delta Charge.description: Holon's tower woke a hidden power in Dragonite and Salamence. Rayquaza ex δ flew in from the islands where dragons rule.

Dragon Roar.description: Beyond the horizon lie the islands where dragons rule. Dragonite ex δ roars among their pine forests.

Holon Inferno.description: Tyranitar δ grew up in the shadow of Holon's tower. At Holon Lake, Kingdra δ and Gyarados ★ burn with the same fire.

Delta Thunder.description: At Holon Lake, Gyarados δ and Pidgeot δ crackle with Lightning. Metagross δ answers from the research tower.

Peal of Thunder.description: On a remote island of glowing crystals, Charizard δ breathes lightning. Feraligatr δ swims in from beyond the horizon.

Holon Eevees.description: Eevee adapt to wherever they live. Near Holon's research tower, they evolved into colors seen nowhere else.

Delta Bouquet.description: Nearly every Pokémon at Holon Lake is a Delta Species. Bellossom δ dances among the stone domes as Togetic δ watches.

Holon Dynamo.description: Holon's Pokémon can turn into Energy. From them, the researchers learned to make Holon Energy.

Psychic Mirage.description: On the islands beyond the horizon, red cliffs rise from the sea. Flygon ex δ and Ninetales δ shimmer in the heat.

Delta Hunters.description: Mightyena δ and its pack roam the forests around Holon. Sharpedo δ and Exeggutor δ live by the lake to the south.

Dragon Frontiers.description: On the furthest islands stands an ancient stone circle, a holy site of Holon. Gardevoir δ and Meganium δ burn nearby.
